d:
After nearly 20 years, Anubhav found himself in Patna during Durga Puja, soaking in the festive energy of the city. He was joined by Kunal Kumar as they set out to explore the vibrant pandals and festive food that define this time of year.
Our first stop was the iconic Dalbunglow Chauraha Pandal, a celebration that has been taking place since 1964. The atmosphere was filled with devotion and joy. We sought blessings and received sooji halwa as prasad, warm and comforting.
